label: slow down
note: source=soundcloud.com/maddecent/dj-snake-x-yellow-claw-x (DJ Snake x Yellow Claw x Spanker, "Slow Down") — measured 100.000 BPM, downbeat +0.060 s, F minor. 16 lanes over 32 bars: intro kick loop, verse, riser+snare-roll build with the source's one-bar gap, then the drop alternating 4 bars of F1 sub pedal (kick on rows 0,3,6,10,13) with 4 bars of the Eb riff (Bb1-G1-Eb1 at 16ths, kick on 0,3,6,8,11,14). Hook Bb4-C5-Ab4-Bb4-Eb4-Bb4-C5-Bb4-C4-Eb4 doubled an octave up, as the source doubles it. Recomposed, not transcribed: MAKESND says pick the smallest set that covers the mix, and this deliberately does the opposite — every lane the format allows, because that was the brief. Instruments are FITTED, not chosen by name: each lane's knobs come from a search of Sonant's parameter space against a fingerprint measured off this recording — 56-band log spectrum, onset-aligned envelope, and for pitched voices the share of energy on each harmonic of the note. The hook's measured profile has almost no fundamental and 37% of its energy on the second harmonic, and the fitted voice reproduces that; the factory `square` it used to play scored 14x worse on the same measure. Lane trims are solved by NNLS against the record's own band balance.
